maria-marketing: Please paste the YAML we can include in post/playbook. Also want a short benchmark line for hero copy (latency @256 tokens + cost delta).

  canary:
    start: "2026-03-23T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step_pct: 10
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00"```
